title: Chicago 311 Service Request (Curated Sample)
description: JSON Schema describing the structure and types of the curated 311 service request dataset.

SR_SHORT_CODE.description: Short code for service request type

OWNER_DEPARTMENT.description: Department currently responsible for the request

STATUS.description: Current status of the request (e.g., Open, Completed)

ORIGIN.description: How the request was submitted (e.g., Internet, Phone)

CREATED_DATE.description: Date when the request was created

CLOSED_DATE.description: Timestamp when the request was closed

ZIP_CODE.description: Three-digit ZIP prefix in curated dataset

DUPLICATE.description: Whether the request is a duplicate

LEGACY_RECORD.description: Whether the record originates from a legacy system

PARENT_SR_NUMBER.description: Parent service request number, if any

RESOLUTION_TIME_HOURS.description: Computed time to resolution in hours
